carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-intensity crests to shadowed troughs, converging toward the caudal peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged notching on the posterior margin of the upper caudal fin lobe. Multiple remoras are visible attached to the ventral surface between the pelvic and anal fin regions.
other_distinctive_markers: A vertical series of high-luminance circular blobs is clearly visible on the lower lobe of the caudal fin.
